CONSUMER PRICE INDEX - DECEMBER 2024

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in December, after rising 0.3 percent in November.

Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 2.9 percent before seasonal adjustment.

The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.2 percent in December.

The all items less food and energy index rose 3.2 percent over the last 12 months.
